title: Home
subtitle: 「家／住所」，究竟是哪一種「居住地方」？
description: 「家／住所」，究竟是哪一種「居住地方」？

words.note: 較正式，指某人居住的地方，常見於法律、行政、房地產和正式書面語境。
words.example: Applicants must provide their current residence on the form.
words.exampleZh: 申請人必須在表格上填寫目前住所。

exercises.original: Please write your current home address on the application form.
exercises.zh: 請在申請表上填寫目前居住地址。

options.explanation: household = household 是同住的人，不是地址所指的居所。
family = 不是要填家庭成員。
residence = 表格要求正式填寫目前居住地，因此 residence 很自然。

exercises.original: The building is used as the ambassador's official home.
exercises.zh: 這座建築用作大使的官邸。

options.explanation: accommodation = 可以是住宿，但 official residence 是固定正式搭配。
residence = official residence 是官邸、正式住所的固定搭配。

exercises.original: She changed her home after accepting a permanent job in another city.
exercises.zh: 她接受另一城市的長期工作後更改了住所。

options.explanation: household = 她不一定改變家庭成員。
homeland = 不是移居另一城市就改變祖國。
lodging = 永久工作語境未必是臨時住處。
residence = 永久搬到另一城市是 residence 的改變，因此這個正式說法合適。
address = 只改地址資訊不一定等同改居所。

words.note: 較正式、較中性，指供人居住的房屋、單位或其他居住空間，常見於規劃、建築和統計語境。
words.example: The survey counted every occupied dwelling in the district.
words.exampleZh: 調查統計了該區每個有人居住的住宅單位。

exercises.original: The census counted every occupied home in the district.
exercises.zh: 人口普查統計了該區每個有人居住的住宅單位。

options.explanation: household = census 也會統計 households，但本句明確是 occupied housing units。
residence = 可以指住所，但 occupied dwelling 是統計上的常見搭配。
dwelling = census + occupied 表示住宅單位統計，因此 dwelling 最精確。

exercises.original: The planning rules limit the number of homes that can be built on the site.
exercises.zh: 規劃規例限制該地點可興建的住宅單位數量。

options.explanation: residences = 可以，但規劃中 dwellings 更常指住宅單位。
lodgings = 不是一般規劃單位。
dwelling = 規劃規例計算可建多少住宅單位，標準用語是 dwellings。

exercises.original: The storm damaged more than fifty homes in the village.
exercises.zh: 暴風雨損壞了村內五十多個住宅。

options.explanation: households = 住戶本身不能被 storm damaged 作建築含義。
dwelling = 句子說的是被損壞的實體住宅，因此正式中性的 dwellings 很合適。

words.note: 不是建築物本身，而是同住並共同生活的一群人；只有當 home 指家庭單位或家中成員時才可替換。
words.example: The programme provides support to low-income households.
words.exampleZh: 這項計劃為低收入住戶提供支援。

exercises.original: The survey asked each home how much electricity it used each month.
exercises.zh: 調查詢問每個住戶每月使用多少電力。

options.explanation: dwelling = 如果問的是使用者群體，household 比實體 dwelling 更自然。
residence = 住所本身不會回答 survey。
house = 建築物不是受訪者。
address = 地址不會用電作社會統計單位。
household = 能源調查以同住生活單位為對象，因此 household 最精確。
homestead = 不合一般住戶統計。

exercises.original: The benefit is available to homes with an annual income below the limit.
exercises.zh: 這項福利提供給年收入低於上限的住戶。

options.explanation: residences = 住宅本身沒有 income。
homesteads = 不合一般福利政策。
household = annual income 屬於同住的人群，而不是建築，因此應用 households。

exercises.original: Every home received one emergency kit.
exercises.zh: 每個住戶獲發一套緊急物資。

options.explanation: household = 按每個生活單位發放一份物資，household 能包括各種同住安排。
dwelling = 若重點是分配給居民單位，household 更自然。
residence = 不是具體受益人群。
family = 可能排除非親屬同住者。
house = 會排除公寓等住宅形式。

words.note: 當 home 指具體住宅建築時，house 是最常見的替換之一；但 house 強調建築，home 更可帶感情和歸屬感。
words.example: They bought a small house near the coast.
words.exampleZh: 他們在海岸附近買了一間小房子。

exercises.original: They bought a new home with three bedrooms and a small garden.
exercises.zh: 他們買了一間有三間睡房和小花園的新房子。

options.explanation: residence = 可用但較正式，而且本句是日常購屋。
accommodation = 通常不會說 bought accommodation。
house = 三房加花園明確描述一棟住宅建築，日常最自然是 house。

exercises.original: Their home has a red door and a large kitchen.
exercises.zh: 他們的房子有紅色大門和大型廚房。

options.explanation: house = door 和 kitchen 是建築物特徵，因此 house 最直接。
residence = 可用但語氣過正式。

exercises.original: The old home at the end of the road was built in 1890.
exercises.zh: 道路盡頭的老房子建於1890年。

options.explanation: house = was built in 1890 明確指建築物，因此 house 最精確。
residence = 可用但日常描述建築年份時 house 更自然。

words.note: 正式而清楚，表示某人通常居住的地方，常見於表格、法律和行政文件。
words.example: Your place of residence determines which local office handles the application.
words.exampleZh: 你的居住地決定由哪個地方辦事處處理申請。

exercises.original: The form asks for your home and nationality.
exercises.zh: 表格要求填寫你的居住地和國籍。
exercises.upgrade: place of residence · 居住地；住所

options.explanation: place of residence = 和 nationality 並列的行政資訊通常是 place of residence。
house = 過於具體，可能住在 apartment。
hometown = 出生／成長地不一定是現居地。

exercises.original: Tax rules may depend on a person's main home.
exercises.zh: 稅務規則可能取決於一個人的主要居住地。
exercises.upgrade: place of residence · 居住地；住所

options.explanation: household = 稅務 residence 概念不是住戶本身。
place of residence = 正式行政／稅務語境需要表達主要居住地，因此 place of residence 很自然。

exercises.original: Participants were grouped according to their home.
exercises.zh: 參加者按其居住地分組。
exercises.upgrade: place of residence · 居住地；住所

options.explanation: house = 不是按房屋類型分組。
household = 不是按共同住戶分組。
place of residence = 按參加者居住地區作分類時，正式說 place of residence 最清楚。

words.note: 較正式或文學化，表示某人居住的地方；現代日常英語較少用。
words.example: The cottage became his permanent abode after retirement.
words.exampleZh: 退休後，這間小屋成為他的永久居所。

exercises.original: After retirement, the cottage became his permanent home.
exercises.zh: 退休後，這間小屋成為他的永久居所。

options.explanation: abode = permanent abode 是較正式、文學式的永久居所表達。
lodging = permanent 與臨時 lodging 不符。
accommodation = 可指住處，但 permanent abode 更書面。

exercises.original: The traveller finally returned to his quiet home in the hills.
exercises.zh: 旅人終於回到山中的寧靜居所。

options.explanation: abode = 文學敘述中的 quiet home 可自然改寫為 quiet abode。

exercises.original: For many years, the small cabin served as her home.
exercises.zh: 多年來，這間小木屋一直是她的居所。

options.explanation: abode = 較書面地描述 cabin 作為長期居所，可用 abode。
lodging = many years 不一定是 temporary lodging。

words.note: 法律和正式行政用語，指一個人法律上視為永久居所的地方；不能在一般日常語境中隨意代替 home。
words.example: The court considered her legal domicile when reviewing the case.
words.exampleZh: 法院審理案件時考慮了她的法定住所。

exercises.original: The court had to determine his legal home for tax purposes.
exercises.zh: 法院需要為稅務目的確定他的法定住所。
exercises.upgrade: domicile · 法定住所；永久居籍

options.explanation: residence = 日常 residence 未必等同法律上的 permanent domicile。
domicile = court、legal、tax purposes 明確是法律上的 domicile 概念。

exercises.original: A person may have several residences but only one legal home under this rule.
exercises.zh: 按這項規則，一個人可以有數個住所，但只有一個法定居籍。
exercises.upgrade: domicile · 法定住所；永久居籍

options.explanation: dwelling = 實體住宅可以有多個。
domicile = 句子特別對比 multiple residences 與單一法律居籍，因此 domicile 最精確。
house = 不合抽象法律區分。
accommodation = 不是法律身份概念。

exercises.original: The dispute concerned whether the country was still his permanent legal home.
exercises.zh: 爭議涉及該國是否仍是他的永久法定居籍。
exercises.upgrade: domicile · 法定住所；永久居籍

options.explanation: residence = 可能是實際居住地，但本句問 legal status。
homeland = 是身份／故土概念，不是法律居籍。
dwelling = 不合國家層級法律身份。
domicile = legal + country-level permanent connection 是 domicile 的典型用法。

words.note: 通常指某人實際生活、睡眠的空間，常見於宿舍、船舶、軍營、工作場所或共用建築。
words.example: The crew's living quarters are located below deck.
words.exampleZh: 船員的居住空間位於甲板下方。

exercises.original: The crew's home on the ship is located below deck.
exercises.zh: 船員在船上的居住空間位於甲板下方。
exercises.upgrade: living quarters · 居住空間；住處

options.explanation: household = crew 是人群，但不是空間。
residence = 可以泛稱，但船上具體起居區更自然是 living quarters。
living quarters = 船舶中供 crew 睡眠和生活的區域，固定說法是 living quarters。

exercises.original: Workers were shown their home area inside the remote camp.
exercises.zh: 工人獲帶領參觀偏遠營地內的居住區。
exercises.upgrade: living quarters · 居住空間；住處

options.explanation: houses = 營地不一定是一棟棟 house。
living quarters = camp 內指定的住宿起居區最自然稱 living quarters。

exercises.original: The research station has separate homes for the scientific and technical teams.
exercises.zh: 研究站為科研和技術團隊設有分開的居住空間。
exercises.upgrade: living quarters · 居住空間；住處

options.explanation: households = 不是同住家庭單位。
residences = 可用但不如 living quarters 指站內具體區域。
lodgings = 可以，但不如 quarters 適合 institutional site。
living quarters = 研究站內為不同團隊設置的住宿區域，living quarters 最精確。

words.note: 常見於英式英語，指可供居住或暫住的地方；特別適合學生、旅客、員工住房等語境。
words.example: The university provides accommodation for first-year students.
words.exampleZh: 大學為一年級學生提供住宿。

exercises.original: The university provides homes for first-year students.
exercises.zh: 大學為一年級學生提供住宿。

options.explanation: houses = 大學可能提供 dorms 或 rooms，不一定是 houses。
accommodation = 學生住宿可包括宿舍、房間或公寓，總稱 accommodation 最自然。

exercises.original: The employer arranged a home for staff working at the remote site.
exercises.zh: 僱主為在偏遠地點工作的員工安排住宿。

options.explanation: residence = 較像正式住址，未必強調提供住宿。
house = 可能不止一種住房形式。
accommodation = arranged ... for staff 是典型住宿安排語境，因此 accommodation 最貼切。

exercises.original: Finding an affordable home near the campus can be difficult.
exercises.zh: 在校園附近尋找價格可負擔的住宿可能很困難。

options.explanation: accommodation = 學生／校園附近尋找可住的地方，accommodation 比 house 更全面。
house = 會把選項限制為獨立房屋。

words.note: 通常指暫時住宿的地方，常見於旅行、工作或短期居留；比 home 的永久性和歸屬感弱。
words.example: The workers were given temporary lodging near the construction site.
words.exampleZh: 工人獲安排在工地附近的臨時住處。

exercises.original: The company provided a temporary home for workers during the project.
exercises.zh: 公司在項目期間為工人提供臨時住處。

options.explanation: residence = 可以是住所，但 temporary + project 更偏 lodging。
lodging = temporary 和 during the project 都明確表示短期住宿，因此 lodging 最精確。

exercises.original: Travellers searched for a cheap home for the night.
exercises.zh: 旅客尋找便宜的過夜住處。

options.explanation: lodging = for the night 是短期住宿，lodging 很自然。
residence = 不會通常用於一晚住宿。

exercises.original: Seasonal workers need a home close to the farms during harvest.
exercises.zh: 季節工在收成期間需要農場附近的住宿。

options.explanation: lodging = seasonal workers 的短期居住需求，最適合 lodging。

words.note: 常指連同土地在內的家庭住宅或長期家園，尤其帶有鄉村、農地或家族定居意味。
words.example: The old farmhouse remained the family's homestead for generations.
words.exampleZh: 這座老農舍世代都是這個家庭的家園。

exercises.original: The old farmhouse remained the family's home for generations.
exercises.zh: 這座老農舍世代都是這個家庭的家園。

options.explanation: homestead = farmhouse + for generations 強調長期家族家園，因此 homestead 最自然。
accommodation = 缺乏家族和土地傳承意味。

exercises.original: They returned to the rural home where their grandparents had lived.
exercises.zh: 他們回到祖父母曾居住的鄉間家園。

options.explanation: homestead = rural 加上 grandparents 的代際連結，很適合 homestead。
residence = 可用但缺少 rural family-estate 味道。

exercises.original: The family worked together to preserve its historic home and surrounding land.
exercises.zh: 這家人合力保存歷史家園及周圍土地。

options.explanation: household = 不是被保存的地方。
homestead = home and surrounding land 正是 homestead 常見的房屋加土地概念。

words.note: 當 home 指的是家庭生活的環境而不是具體地址或建築時可用，常見於社會研究、醫療和教育語境。
words.example: The study examined how children behave in a domestic setting.
words.exampleZh: 研究探討兒童在家庭環境中的行為。

exercises.original: Researchers observed how children communicated at home rather than at school.
exercises.zh: 研究人員觀察兒童在家庭環境而非學校中的溝通方式。
exercises.upgrade: domestic setting · 家庭環境；居家環境

options.explanation: residence = 只是住所地點，不突出家庭生活環境。
domestic setting = 研究比較 home 與 school 兩種社會環境，因此 domestic setting 最精確。

exercises.original: The device was tested at home before being introduced into hospitals.
exercises.zh: 這個裝置先在居家環境測試，之後才引入醫院。
exercises.upgrade: domestic setting · 家庭環境；居家環境

options.explanation: residence = 不如 setting 適合 test environment。
domestic setting = 和 hospitals 對比的是使用環境，因此 domestic setting 很自然。

exercises.original: The programme studies how older adults manage daily tasks at home.
exercises.zh: 這項計劃研究長者如何在家庭環境中處理日常活動。
exercises.upgrade: domestic setting · 家庭環境；居家環境

options.explanation: residence = 只說地址／住所，不突出生活情境。
domestic setting = daily tasks 指居家生活情境，因此 domestic setting 最貼切。

falseSynonyms.zh: 家庭成員不等於住所 family 指有親屬關係的人；home 可以指居住的地方，也可以帶家庭歸屬感，但兩者並不等同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A family may live in a home, but the family is the people, not the building.

falseSynonyms.zh: 房屋與家的概念不完全相同 house 主要是建築物；home 可以是任何居所，也常包含歸屬感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A house is a building; a home is the place where someone lives and may feel they belong.

falseSynonyms.zh: 住戶不等於住宅 household 指同住的一群人；如果句子說的是實體居所，就不能直接用 household。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A household lives in a home; it is not the home itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 地址不等於家 address 是位置資訊；home 是實際居住地或家。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An address tells you where a home is located.

falseSynonyms.zh: 物業不等於家 property 是法律或商業上的不動產概念，可以是住宅、土地或其他資產。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A property can be a home, but not every property is someone's home.

falseSynonyms.zh: 家與家鄉不同 home 是居住地或家的概念；hometown 是某人的家鄉或成長城市。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She returned home after work. Her hometown is several hours away.

falseSynonyms.zh: 家與祖國／故土不同 homeland 通常指國家、民族故土或祖籍地，比個人住所範圍大得多。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He lives in a new home abroad but still feels connected to his homeland.

falseSynonyms.zh: 住所與居民不同 residence 是居住地方；resident 是住在某地的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This building is her residence. She is a resident of the city.
